newsitem.title: USA: CITIBANK CITES GLOBAL RESOURCES IN AD AGENCY PICK.
newsitem.headline: CITIBANK CITES GLOBAL RESOURCES IN AD AGENCY PICK.

text.p: Citibank says the global network of Young & Rubicam led to the decision to select that firm to handle the bank's consolidated advertising account.

Citibank, a unit of Citicorp, stunned Madison Avenue on Thursday by turning away from its existing roster of agencies and naming Young & Rubicam to handle an estimated $500 million worldwide branding campaign.
The announcement capped a yearlong review of all communications tasks with an eye toward consolidating its advertising and direct marketing, bank officials said.

"We were looking at our total global needs," said Susan Weeks, Citibank vice president for public affairs. "We are at a point in time where we needed particular resources. Y&R's global offices matches our network."

Citibank had previously assigned its communications tasks to three primary agencies -- Foote, Cone & Belding, a unit of True North Communications Inc ; Lowe & Partners, part of Interpublic Group of Cos' Lowe Group; and J. Walter Thompson, a unit of WPP Group Plc.
In addition to consumer advertising, Young & Rubicam will be responsible for all Citibank communications, including corporate.
Weeks said the combined expenditures for advertising and direct marketing will reach about $500 million.

"A strong global brand is vitally important to our growth strategy," William Campbell, executive vice president for global consumer business, said in a statement. "Today's decision is based clearly on our goal of being the global bank, with one global brand, speaking with one global voice."
Officials said Citibank had decided three years ago to work toward establishing a distinctive brand and earlier this year formed a global consumer marketing unit under Brian Ruder.
The announcement was a major victory for privately held, New York-based Young & Rubicam.
"We are very proud that a company as visionary as Citibank has confidence in our ability to be its global partner," Y&R Chairman Peter Georgescu said.
